Site name: UndefeatedXI
URL: https://www.undefeatedxi.com/

UndefeatedXI is the official soccer and football version of the viral 82-0 game, built as a football history draft simulator where players draft an all-time XI and chase unbeaten records.

Agent Lab: completed runs can be audited by a grounded multi-agent workflow. A squad scout and tactical analyst evaluate structured game data, a critic challenges the plan, and a manager returns evidence-backed changes with inspectable traces, schema validation, guardrails, and deterministic failure recovery.

Important pages:
- Home and game: https://www.undefeatedxi.com/
- 82-0 soccer game landing page: https://www.undefeatedxi.com/82-0-soccer-game
- 82-0 football game landing page: https://www.undefeatedxi.com/82-0-football-game
- How to play: https://www.undefeatedxi.com/how-to-play
- Leaderboard: https://www.undefeatedxi.com/leaderboard
- Contact and feedback: https://www.undefeatedxi.com/contact

Target identity: UndefeatedXI is the official soccer and football version of 82-0, focused on football draft simulations, all-time XIs, perfect seasons, World Cup runs, leaderboards, and shareable results.
